summary: Wrote a six-phase, 5.5-hour implementation plan for the record-versioning rule, its taxonomy standard, and the shared pattern library plus three wiring surfaces, all in the source store agent-system/extensions/core/. The plan integrates the research report's wiring correction (manifest.json provides.context is directory-granular, so the new standards file needs no entry) and its evidence-based BLOCKING/ADVISORY tiering. Plan-time measurement surfaced one risk the report did not cover: the eager-context budget sits at exactly zero headroom (65,950 B against a 65,950 B baseline), so adding an eager rule file would fail verify-deploy gate 20; a dedicated reconciliation phase handles it via the trim-and-relocate precedent rather than moving the recorded baseline. The plan validates clean under validate-artifact.sh (0 warnings).

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: shared pattern library, discriminator calibration plus test suite, taxonomy standard and rule file, wiring, eager-context budget reconciliation, redeploy and full gate set.
